summary: Spark's case mapping: no locale precondition; Spark's writer pins the case locale in the plan by lowering non-ASCII UPPER/LOWER to collate(upper(collate(x,'UNICODE')),'UTF8_BINARY'); the guard narrows once facts L1-L4 are recorded. No D-number.
note: Answers C2's second gap of the D51 raise-set ruling (F62). A user statement of the cluster locale is ruled out; would be the user's decision only if L1 or L3 fails.
